title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
constraints: p and q are distinct values present in the tree
inputFormat: Implement lowestCommonAncestorOfABinarySearchTree(root, p, q). The editor converts the level-order root array (null marks missing children) into nodes with val, left, and right. p and q are integer values, not node objects.
outputFormat: Return the integer value of the lowest common ancestor, not a node object.
